criteria.description: The duel starts normally and reaches a controllable arena state.
Light and heavy attacks have distinct timing and damage, spend stamina, and cannot be canceled without meaningful commitment.
Boss telegraphs can be read and damage can be avoided through positioning or a visibly timed dodge window rather than arbitrary immunity.
The boss demonstrates multiple distinguishable anticipation, active, and recovery patterns, and phase two materially changes the fight rather than only recoloring it.
Limited healing is readable, capped, and exposes the player to interruption or punishment while it is used.
Damage, stamina, recovery openings, win/loss states, and restart form a coherent duel that is neither obviously impossible nor trivial.
Characters, lock state, health, stamina, attack telegraphs, hit feedback, and arena boundaries remain readable during combat.
At 390 x 844 the full move, camera, lock, light, heavy, dodge, and heal control set is reachable and combat remains legible without overlap.
